source: A preset can be exclusive. When an exclusive preset applies, x18n tests no preset after it. {0} and {1} are exclusive. {2} has no detection, so it applies only when you list it.
text: 预设可以是独占的。当独占预设生效时，x18n 不会再测试排在它之后的任何预设。{0} 和 {1} 是独占的。{2} 没有检测机制，因此只有在你列出它时才会生效。
